title: Senior Product Manager, Fleet Platform APIs
posting_text:
Arcadia Fleet's platform connects 80,000 trucks to the shippers that book them.

What you'll do
- Own the fleet platform's partner APIs and webhooks
- Launch a carrier certification program
- Work with telematics partners on data quality

What we're looking for
- 6+ years of product management on B2B platform or API products
- Experience with carrier or partner integration programs
- Data-informed decision making

Nice to have
- Telematics or IoT device experience
- Usage-based pricing
